stories.title: Russian forces hit Black Ammo explosives manufacturer in Borispol
stories.summary: Long-range unmanned aerial vehicles struck the Black Ammo LLC industrial enterprise in Borispol, the Kiev Region, which specializes in the production, procurement, and supply of ammunition and explosives to Ukrainian security forces
article_sentences: Russian forces have hit a facility in Borispol, the Kiev Region, that produces ammunition and explosives for Ukrainian security forces, the Russian Defense Ministry has said.

"Long-range unmanned aerial vehicles struck the Black Ammo LLC industrial enterprise in Borispol, the Kiev Region, which specializes in the production, procurement, and supply of ammunition and explosives to Ukrainian security forces," the ministry said.
